messages:
liz chan: Hey team — Helianthe9 (healthcare analytics) wants a POC. They plan to provide a sanitized sample dataset (~2M tokens) and want us to validate two variants: redwood-chat-13b-rlhf and a customer-supplied custom-quant-13b. Key asks: 

1) Can Dedicated serve the custom-quant-13b with p95 latency <= 250ms?
2) HIPAA/KMS/BAA: what controls do we need?
3) Pricing: rough monthly commit for sustained 100 req/s with avg 512 tokens per response.

hamed: Pinged infra. Dedicated pools look feasible but quant variant needs validation. What's expected KV cache behavior and typical prompt reuse? If they have long contexts memory sizing changes.

priya r: Security side — we can do KMS + VPC private control plane + audit logs. For HIPAA we'll need a BAA and their security questionnaire filled. Ask them to redact PHI in sample where possible.

liz chan: They said PHI is possible in production. Need per-customer isolation. Also legal will likely insist on single-tenant Dedicated or strict VPC controls.

sam k: For latency: 13B quant on a tuned runtime running on A10/A100 class nodes generally yields p95 ~150-220ms at ~512 tokens when batching is minimal. But custom quant can vary. For 100 rps sustained we should propose reserved 8-GPU pool + autoscale. I'll run a bench.

hamed: Note: KV prefix caching can cut GPU work substantially if prompts repeat. If they enable it, we can drop compute by ~25-35%. Need their prompt distribution.

liz chan: Sales needs a back-of-envelope pricing to present in the sync. Any quick numbers?

sam k: Rough calc: 100 rps * 512 tokens = 51,200 tokens/sec -> ~4.4M tokens/day? Wait, let me re-check. 51,200 tokens/sec * 86,400 sec/day = 4,423,680,000 tokens/day -> ~132B tokens/month. Hosted per-token bill would be hefty. With Dedicated and caching the unit cost drops drastically. Recommend we map to GPU-hours and reserved commit. I'll draft a sketch.

ops-bot: [deploy] perf-benchmark job queued: job_id=hb-17888-01

priya r: For HIPAA we'll need: BAA, encrypted-at-rest (KMS), private control plane, VPC peering or S3 VPC endpoints, audit log forwarding. I'll attach our BAA template and checklist. Also ask if they need SOC2 Type II evidence.

liz chan: On model variants — should we run redwood-chat-13b-rlhf baseline first and then the custom quant for cost/latency comparison?

sam k: Yes. Baseline with redwood-chat-13b-rlhf for quality/regressions, then split traffic 70/30 to custom-quant to measure delta. If quant fails perf, fallback to float16.

hamed: Compilation note: custom quant/model may need a compile pass and kernel selection. Compilation window ~4-12 hours depending on model and node types. Share the weights in the format we require (tar.gz + manifest).

sam k: Also need an adapter spec if they used nonstandard tokenizers or embeddings. Send adapter spec link: https://intra.redwood/adapter-spec (sent in DM).

liz chan: Action items:
- priya r: lead security questionnaire/BAA (ETA 2 business days)
- sam k: perf calc + kick bench job (ETA 1 business day)
- hamed: confirm Dedicated sizing + compile ETA (ETA 2 business days)
- liz chan: request model artifacts & representative prompt set from customer

priya r: Noted. I'll loop in legal for the BAA and ask for their security contact. Also confirm whether they need audit logs shipped to their SIEM.

(sanitized quote from customer's DM): "We can provide a private S3 link with model weights and a sanitized dataset. If PHI cannot be fully redacted, we can discuss an on-prem dropbox — how would that change timelines?"

liz chan: Private S3 via VPC endpoint is fine. On-prem ingestion is doable but will add 1-2 weeks and extra legal. Tell them VPC S3 is preferred.

sam k: Bench job started. I'll post numbers + p95 when done.

ops-bot: [job_update] hb-17888-01 status=running nodepool=dedicated-a10x4 eta=approx-30m

hamed: If custom quant doesn't meet perf targets, we can propose float16 quant or our redwood-chat-13b-rlhf until we optimize kernels. Will set rollout policy to auto-fallback.

liz chan: Scheduling a customer sync Friday 09:00 PT. Please be on the call for your action items. Any blockers before then?

priya r: Need the customer's security contact + scope of PHI. Otherwise no blockers.

sam k: Nothing blocking from infra side.

liz chan: Thanks all. I'll update thread after the sync and attach the customer's sample link when received.
